title: Blast embedder protocol v1
description: NDJSON messages of `blast serve` (decision 0011). Each validated instance is one line: an embedder -> server or a server -> embedder message.

capabilities.storage.get.summary: Reads a LocalStorage or internal storage key.

capabilities.storage.set.summary: Writes a LocalStorage or internal storage key.

capabilities.storage.remove.summary: Removes a LocalStorage, internal storage or form draft key.

capabilities.storage.all.summary: Reads every LocalStorage entry for the extension.

capabilities.storage.clear.summary: Clears every LocalStorage entry for the extension.

capabilities.oauth.tokens.get.summary: Reads the stored OAuth token set for a provider.

capabilities.oauth.tokens.set.summary: Stores an OAuth token set for a provider.

capabilities.oauth.tokens.remove.summary: Removes the stored OAuth token set for a provider.

capabilities.oauth.authorize.summary: Asks the client to run an OAuth authorization flow and return a code.

capabilities.ai.ask.summary: Asks an AI model for text; own-provider `{ id }` models are answered by the engine.

capabilities.ai.models.refresh.summary: Re-lists the extension's own AI provider models.

capabilities.ai.decide.summary: Asks a client for typed answers to experimental decision questions.

capabilities.browser.tabs.summary: Lists the browser tabs a client chooses to expose.

capabilities.browser.content.summary: Returns the content of a browser tab.

capabilities.clipboard.copy.summary: Copies text, HTML or a file path to the clipboard.

capabilities.clipboard.paste.summary: Pastes text, HTML or a file path into the frontmost application.

capabilities.clipboard.read.summary: Reads the clipboard, optionally at a history offset.

capabilities.open.url.summary: Opens an HTTP(S) URL, optionally with a named application.

capabilities.open.path.summary: Opens a file or folder, optionally with a named application.

capabilities.selection.text.summary: Returns the selected text; an empty string means nothing is selected.

capabilities.applications.list.summary: Lists installed applications, optionally filtered by path.

capabilities.applications.default.summary: Returns the application the machine would open a path with.

capabilities.finder.show.summary: Reveals a file or folder in the file manager.

capabilities.trash.summary: Moves files or folders to the trash.

capabilities.window.list.summary: Lists the windows on the active desktop.

capabilities.window.setBounds.summary: Moves, resizes or makes a window fullscreen.

capabilities.preferences.open.summary: Asks the client to open extension or command preferences.

capabilities.command.launch.summary: Launches another command, passing arguments and launch context.

capabilities.command.metadata.summary: Updates the command's subtitle in the client.

capabilities.snippet.create.summary: Creates a snippet from text, a name and a keyword.

capabilities.quicklink.create.summary: Creates a quicklink from a link and optional metadata.

capabilities.quicklook.toggle.summary: Toggles Quick Look for the client's selected item.
